title: Stair Lift Design & Manufacturing Plan
desc:
Design a stair lift 
1. Cost & Bill of Materials

• Complete parts list with quantities, materials, suppliers & unit costs

• Clear breakdown: parts cost + manufacturing cost → total per-unit price

2. Manufacturing & Assembly

• Production methods, machining specs, tolerances & finishes for every component

• Step-by-step assembly sequence + key quality checkpoints

• Notes on fabrication feasibility & production scalability

3. Safety, Risk & Environment

• Full hazard identification: mechanical, electrical & operational risks

• Risk assessment + control measures & built-in safety features

• Emergency systems: stop button, obstruction detection, overload protection, backup power, fail-safe braking

• Environmental considerations: material selection, recyclability, energy efficiency & end-of-life disposal

4. CAD & Engineering Drawings

• 3D models: all individual components + full assembled unit

• 2D production drawings: fully dimensioned, toleranced, section views & assembly details

• Standard file formats + PDF drawing package

5. Structural / FEA Analysis

• Select key structural part (rail, carriage, frame or support bracket)

• Simulate under rated load + worst-case conditions

• Stress distribution, deflection & safety factor calculations

• Summary report with findings & recommendations
